title: Starr Wars
versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.label: STAR WAY REPEAT
versions.note: validated payload; runtime untested. Ordered BASIC lines, consistent pointer base, exact-length normal end; exact left/right raw match; runtime untested
versions.unavailableReason: Another recovered save; the site offers one selected player.
versions.startupSource:
1 'STAR WAY         BY CARL KADIE (C) 1979
5 CLEAR1000
7 CLS:GOTO1000
8 '
10 S$=CHR$(183)+" "+CHR$(140)+" "+CHR$(187)
15 D$="<=O=>"
20 CLS
30 EX=.9:EY=2
40 XG=EX:YG=EY
50 PRINT@967,"ESCAPED  0";
60 ET=50000:PRINT@1003,"ENERGY ";ET;:PRINT@980,"DESTROYED  0";
70 F=1
